name: Dr. Adaeze Okoro
about: Adaeze looks after hearts at every age, from palpitations to recovery after surgery. Calm, thorough, and she always explains the numbers.

name: Dr. Samuel Reyes
about: The doctor to start with. Samuel sees adults and teens for check-ups, coughs that will not go away, vaccines and referrals.

name: Dr. Mei Tanaka
about: Mei treats acne, eczema and moles, and runs skin checks with a dermatoscope. She is known for patient, practical routines.

name: Dr. Kwame Asante
about: Kwame has looked after children for sixteen years. Parents come back for how he talks to the child, not just to them.

name: Dr. Lena Fischer
about: Cleanings, fillings and the occasional nervous patient. Lena takes her time and tells you before anything happens.

name: Dr. Omar Haddad
about: Omar specialises in migraine, sleep and nerve pain, and in finding out what actually sets them off.

name: Dr. Grace Mensah
about: Grace offers talking therapy for stress, anxiety and low mood, in person or by video. Sessions are fifty minutes.

name: Dr. Diego Alvarez
about: Diego treats knees, backs and shoulders, and gets runners and footballers back on their feet.
